senses.gloss: शौद्धोदनिः An epithet of Buddha, son of शुद्धोदन.

शौद्र + .{@-द्रः@} The son of a man of any of the first three castes by a Śūdra
 woman; see Ms. 9. 160.

सौदर्यम्^1 n. Brotherhood. ━a. Brotherly or sisterly.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260501. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/174. note: headword change.

सौदामनी, सौदामिनी, सौदाम्नी
—1 Lightning; सौदामन्या कनकनिकषस्निग्धया दर्शयोर्वीम् Me. 39; सौदामिनीव
 जलदोदरसंधिलीना Mk. 1. 35; Māl. 8. 14.
—2 The female of Indraʼs elephant.
—3 A kind of lightning (forked one); काञ्चनाभं नभश्चक्रे विद्युत्सौदामिनी
 यथा Rām. 7. 32. 56; Bhāg. 1. 6. 28.

सौदायिक a. (-की f.)
 Whatever is given to a woman at her marriage by her
 parents, or a relative
[]
 in general, which becomes her own property; मातृपित्रादिभिर्दत्तं धनं
 सौदायिकं स्मृतम् Śukra. 4. 814.
सौदायिक + .{@-कम्@} A nuptial present so made.
